recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a man with long braids and rectangular glasses, mirrored vertically across a central horizontal axis. The subject is captured in profile, emerging from deep shadows against a smooth, amber-gold background, with bold white typography bisecting the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the subject and their reflection
High contrast between deep black shadows and warm amber highlights
Horizontal typographic division of the upper and lower halves
Minimalist color palette focused on monochromatic warmth and stark white text
coreInvariants: Amber/Gold color wash across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal line where the subject meets their reflection, reinforced by the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top subject's face, moves down through the text to the reflection, then back up the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive amber space on the left and right sides creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color variety; the amber is moderately saturated to provide warmth.

composition.position: Centered horizontally, slightly above the midline
Centered horizontally, slightly below the midline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with varied tracking and scale to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, mid-century modern tech aesthetic.
Provides the necessary squareness and extended feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait of a man with long braids and rectangular glasses in profile, looking down. Use low-key lighting with a strong amber/gold color grade. Mirror the image vertically so the bottom half is an exact reflection of the top. The background should be a smooth, solid amber gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, extended geometric sans-serif text in all caps. The top line should be large and tightly tracked, positioned just above the center. The bottom line should be smaller with very wide tracking, positioned just below the center. Add a standard black and white parental advisory logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly amber, black, and white?
Does the text use an extended geometric sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the amber color grade
Tracking width of the secondary text
Vertical spacing between the two text lines
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or advisory text content
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the subject's silhouette
Ensure the reflection line is perfectly horizontal
Verify the amber tone is consistent across the top and bottom halves
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject Profile + Vertical Reflection + Amber Color Grade + Extended Geometric Sans-Serif Typography
